semantics.annual_return: year-end equity divided by preceding session equity, initial cash for first year
semantics.rolling_return: 252 retained sessions, 21-session step, incomplete trailing windows excluded
semantics.excess_return: candidate net return minus embedded buy_hold return on the same continuous-account slice
semantics.holding: positive-quantity bar/session-close observation fraction, not elapsed wall-clock exposure
semantics.drawdown: slice-opening and full-account inherited peak reported separately; positive magnitudes
semantics.independence: development comparisons and overlapping windows are not independent validation
semantics.economic_acceptance: descriptive account comparisons; no automatic research acceptance or stage advancement
